source_instruction: i'm looking for a set of makeup brushes in the color peaceful purple to help me with my eyeshadow makeup.
query: I stopped at the little bakery stand right by the mall entrance on my way in today, and the sweet, warm smell of fresh lavender shortbread hit me so hard I almost lingered there long enough to miss the store’s opening announcement. The barista at the attached coffee spot was passing out tiny sample cups of iced honey lavender latte, too, and it was so smooth and lightly floral I almost grabbed a full size before I remembered I already had a half-drunk cold brew in my tote bag slung over my shoulder. A kid walking past with their parent had on the cutest fuzzy purple dinosaur backpack covered in glittery star stickers, and they waved at me when I smiled at it, which made the whole start of my errand run feel way brighter than I expected when I dragged myself out of the house this morning. I’ve heard the makeup sets section has options that include peaceful purple eye gloss in them, and I don’t go over that amount I always stick to for small makeup picks.
